basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer from Tigard, Oregon, and a huge NBA 2K enthusiast. I spend most of my evenings after work grinding in MyCareer mode or discussing game strategies online. When I'm not on the virtual court, you can find me coding or exploring new tech trends. I'm an early bird, so I'm usually online from around 6 PM to 10 PM PST. Single and loving it, I’m all about improving my game and my coding skills.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a bachelor's degree from Oregon State University. My expertise in software development and coding comes from both formal education and years of self-teaching through online courses and forums. My passion for NBA 2K started in college, where I spent countless hours mastering gameplay mechanics and strategies.
